# Proposed Change

## Change Type(s)
Put an `x` in each box that applies.

- [ ] :sparkles: `(feat)` **New Feature** (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] :bug: `(fix)` **Bug Fix** (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] :recycle: `(redo)` **Code Refactoring** (structural change without changing intended behavior)
- [ ] :memo: `(docs)` **Documentation** (comments, docs)
- [ ] :test_tube: `(test)` **Testing** (unit, integration, acceptance, regression)
- [ ] :broom: `(chore)` **Chore / Maintenance** (setup, config, pipelines, dependencies)
- [ ] :stopwatch: `(perf)` **Performance** (optimization or benchmarking)
- [ ] :shield: `(vuls)` **Security** (hardening, validation, vulnerability fixes)

## Summary
Describe the change in direct terms. State what changed, why it changed, and what part of the project it affects.

## Linked Issue
Closes or relates to: `#<issue-number>`

## Validation
- [ ] I ran the app locally without errors.
- [ ] I ran the relevant tests locally (Vitest).
- [ ] I ran lint, format, and type checks (pnpm run lint, pnpm run typecheck).
- [ ] The change meets the [code standards](../docs/code-standards.md).
- [ ] I verified this change against the issue acceptance criteria.
- [ ] I updated documentation or comments where needed.
- [ ] I updated CHANGELOG.md to describe this change.
- [ ] The PR title is the squash subject: `<type>: <summary>`, 50 characters or fewer.
- [ ] The issue is referenced in the body, for example `Closes #10`.

## Additional Notes
Design decisions, trade-offs, follow ups, screenshots, or anything that helps a reviewer understand the change quickly.
